content:
asha: Heads-up: onboarding review with Beacon tomorrow 11:30 ET. They asked for a clear SLO/credit walkthrough and examples for mixed workloads (embed + chat).
tom: Noted. Which endpoints are in scope? encoder/embeddings + text-gen?
devon: They're using both embeddings and generation. Contract spells uptime for inference API overall and separate latency targets per model-family.
ryan_sre: Current metrics: overall uptime (30d rolling), embeddings p95 target=120ms, gen p95 target=300ms. We also track p99 for both.
asha: They specifically asked how credits are prorated for partial outages (e.g., 3h outage during a month). Need a precise formula in writing.
tom: Proposed wording: credit = min(cap, round(((target - observed) / target) * monthly_commit, 2)). If outage < 6h, we prorate by outage_seconds / month_seconds and apply only if observed < target.
devon: Important: embed-heavy jobs run large-batch offline loads. We need to exclude scheduled bulk-import windows (pre-agreed) from credit calculation.
asha: Agreed. Also include an example table: small outage -> $X, medium outage -> $Y, long outage -> $Z (with numbers).
ryan_sre: I'll export sample CSVs for the past quarter showing incidents and how formula would have changed credits. Will add a column "excluded_window" for maintenance.
deploy-bot: pipeline: slo-export -> customer-docs build started. status: succeeded. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/slo-export/1725006789
tom: Can we also show a separate column that attributes which service caused the latency spike (router vs runtime) so CS can explain root cause?
devon: We have attribution heuristics from traces. I'll add a short note explaining uncertainty +/- 10%.
asha: Action list before review meeting:
- tom: assemble sample table + two worked examples (embed heavy month, gen-heavy month)
- ryan_sre: attach CSV + incident timeline + attribution column
- devon: draft customer-facing FAQ blurb about maintenance exclusion and measurement windows
- asha: consolidate into a single slide deck and invite Beacon CSM/TAM
tom: ETA EOD today for tables.
ryan_sre: CSVs ready by 18:00 PT, will drop in this thread.
devon: FAQ draft in #customer-success-drafts in 1hr.
asha: One more ask from Beacon: they want an automatic monthly SLO report email. Can we push a delivery option?
ryan_sre: We can enable scheduled export + email via reports service. I'll enable for Beacon if legal ok with FYI content.
tom: Fine to send basic metrics + example credit calc. No raw logs.
asha: Perfect. I'll confirm scope with Beacon and send invite. Thanks all :raised_hands:
_test_note: Slack thread formatted as single string. Messages chronological, short, with action items and bot note.
